pages.text: A Radiant Amphora acts as a long distance connection to a specific $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radianttank)Radiant Tank$(/l). You can bind a Radiant Amphora to a Radiant Tank by using the amphora on the desired tank while sneaking. The amphora will become colorized to signify that a connection was made.

You can switch the Radiant Amphora's current mode by left clicking the air.$(br2)A Radiant Amphora placed in a Dispenser will attempt to place fluid from its linked tank if the speace in front of the Dispenser is empty. If the space in front of the Dispenser has a fluid block, the Amphora will instead attempt to pick it up and send it to its linked tank.
Radiant Amphorae can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
